title: DDGS 1.3.0
release_notes:
• Search 10 engines privately — no account, no tracking
• Download videos in your chosen quality; save images to your device
• Scrape any page as Markdown, HTML, rich text or plain text and save it
• New: share any result in one tap · New: image & video search filters
• Faster page fetching, snappier UI, settings never lost on exit
• Under the hood: Flet 1.0, ddgs 9.16, primp 2.0
